events.name: Spooky Season Begins
events.intro: **"Lanterns lit, and the dead have walked out to the road!"** Pumpkins grin on every gatepost. Somewhere, a parade is tuning up.

success.text: You throw a sheet over your head and cut out two eye holes. The Ghost-types on the road take one look and decide you are one of them. They are friendlier all week, and the Pumpkin King and the Midnight Parade are out there somewhere.
You go as you are. Spooky forms rustle in the long grass, and somewhere out there, the Pumpkin King and the Midnight Parade are waiting.

events.name: Winter Festival
events.intro: **"Snow, lights and gifts for everyone!"** A tree in the square, strung with lights, and a pile of presents underneath.

success.text: You leave a gift under the tree for someone you will never meet. It feels better than any present you have opened. Somewhere out in the snow, the Frost King stirs, and the gift swap is open.
A little parcel with your name spelled wrong on it. Inside, something useful. Somewhere out in the snow, the Frost King stirs, and the gift swap is open.

events.name: Lunar New Year
events.intro: **"Red lanterns, dragon dances, lucky envelopes!"** Drums in the street and a dragon made of people, weaving through the crowd.

success.text: You dance under the dragon's tail, and your Dragon-types dance with you, roaring along with the drums. At the end, an old lady presses a red envelope into your hand: ₽888, for luck.
You hang a red lantern on the line with the others and make a wish. An old lady presses a red envelope into your hand: ₽888, for luck.

events.name: Friendship Festival
events.intro: **"Bring your friends, all of them, every last one!"** Blankets on every lawn.

success.text: You spread a blanket and your whole team piles onto it. All week long, every moment you share counts for a little more.

events.name: Spring Bloom
events.intro: **"The first flowers are out, and so are the eggs!"** Gracidea everywhere, and children with baskets.

success.text: You ask around. The egg hunt is in the meadow, and every hidden place on this road is marked for you.
You ask about the Guardian. People lower their voices: it keeps the first bloom, in a meadow nobody can quite find. Now you know where to look.

events.name: Summer Splash
events.intro: **"Sun, sea, and the biggest beach battle of the year!"**

success.text: You swim out past the breakers with your team, and the tide pools shine on the way back. Everyone comes out of the sea refreshed.
A warm-up match on the sand with a swimmer who is far too good at this.

events.name: Duo Week
events.intro: **"Two hearts, one battle!"** Every match this week is fought in pairs, and pays like it.

choices.label: Pick a pair from the team.

success.text: You pick this one, and your lead to stand beside it. All week, doubles pay half again, and the two of them fight like they planned it.

events.name: Cherry Blossom Picnic
events.intro: **"The blossom only lasts a week. Sit under it while you can."**

success.text: You lie under the blossom with your team until the petals cover all of you. Everyone is rested, and something small and green watches from the next tree, pleased.

events.name: Rainbow Parade
events.intro: **"Everyone, exactly as they are!"** A parade under a rainbow that does not fade.

success.text: You march, and your team marches with you, ribbons on everyone. Overhead, the rainbow burns brighter, and something with burning wings crosses it, once.
You cheer from the side until your voice goes. Overhead, the rainbow burns brighter, and something with burning wings crosses it, once.

events.name: Midsummer Night
events.intro: **"The shortest night of the year. Nobody sleeps."** Fireflies, and music from the woods.

success.text: You stay up. Fairies and bugs dance in the dark, and a light comes on in a place on the map you had not noticed before.

effects.label: Midsummer Night: Fairy and Bug Pokémon about

success.text: You sleep through it, and wake to dew and birdsong, everyone rested.

events.name: Fireworks Festival
events.intro: **"Tonight the sky catches fire!"**

success.text: You lie on the hill and watch. Your team gasps at every one. So do you.
Your Fire-type lights the fuses one by one, and the whole crowd cheers its name.

events.name: Harvest Moon
events.intro: **"The trees are heavy this year. Take what you need."**

success.text: Under the big orange moon, the trees give twice what they should. Your bag is full of Berries.

events.name: The Feast
events.intro: **"A long table, and room for everyone."**

success.text: You eat until nobody can move. Everyone is whole again.
You bring a trainer you met on the road, and they are so happy to be asked. Everyone is whole again, and they will remember you asked.

events.name: Winter Solstice
events.intro: **"The longest night. Walk it, or wait for the dawn."**

success.text: You walk the longest night with your team close around you. Ghosts and Dark-types watch from the trees, and once, at the darkest hour, a shape like a black cloud with a single blue eye passes over you, and your dreams are strange for days.

effects.label: Solstice: Ghost and Dark Pokémon about

success.text: You stay by the fire until the dawn comes back. Everyone rests.

events.name: Spring Equinox
events.intro: **"Day and night, exactly equal. Stand in the balance."**

success.text: You stand on the line between the sun and the moon. For a moment you feel both, and something vast, made of light, notices.

effects.text: Stood in the balance at the equinox.

events.name: Autumn Equinox
events.intro: **"The deer are changing their coats."**

success.text: In the gold woods you find them: Deerling and Sawsbuck in their autumn coats. They are everywhere this week.

events.name: Festival of Lights
events.intro: **"Every lamp is lit tonight. Follow them home."**

success.text: You follow the lamps, and they lead you down paths you would never have found: two hidden places, lit for you.
You light a lamp for someone who needs it, and leave it in a window.

events.name: Moon Festival
events.intro: **"Moon cakes, and the biggest moon of the year."**

success.text: You share a moon cake with your lead under the full moon. Baked into the middle, for luck: a Moon Stone.

events.name: Day of the Dead
events.intro: **"Marigolds on every grave, and a candle for every friend."**

choices.label: Leave marigolds for a lost friend.

success.text: You leave marigolds for the ones you lost on this road. For one moment, in the candlelight, you see them again, just as they were. Then the wind moves the flames, and the way to the Lantern Sea is open.
Skeletons and Ghost-types dance down the street together. It is joyful, and sad, and joyful again. The way to the Lantern Sea is open.

events.name: Brew Fair
events.intro: **"Berry Juice, every flavour, first cup free!"**

success.text: A cup of Berry Juice for everyone on the team. Everyone feels a little better.

events.name: Harvest Festival
events.intro: **"Many hands, light work!"** Carts of grain and a farmer who keeps losing track of things.

success.text: You help bring the harvest in. The farmer thanks you three times, forgetting each time that he already did, and pays you for the day.

events.name: Pokémon Day
events.intro: **"Every first partner, out in the wild for one day!"**

success.text: Out in the long grass, a first partner Pokémon, wild and curious, comes trotting up to see who you are.

events.name: Earth Week
events.intro: **"Clean the river, plant a tree, leave it better!"**

success.text: You sign up for the Big Cleanup. Rock, Ground and Grass Pokémon come out to see the cleared banks all week.

effects.label: Earth Week: Rock, Ground and Grass Pokémon about

events.name: Stargazing Nights
events.intro: **"Look up. Something might look back."**

success.text: You lie in the grass and watch the stars all night. Rare Pokémon come out on nights like this.

events.name: Trainer Academy Week
events.intro: **"Open classes for every trainer on the road!"**

success.text: You enrol. All week, the study halls are open and the Academy Exam is on, and every trainer on the road is training harder: two levels stronger, and paying a fifth more.

events.name: Berry Festival
events.intro: **"Plant a Berry, guard a tree, win a prize!"**

success.text: You plant a Berry in the festival ground and pat the soil down. "Come back down the road," says the gardener. "It will have grown."
Berry thieves! You stand in front of the festival tree.

events.name: Your Berry Tree
events.intro: The Berry you planted at the festival has come up: a little tree, heavy with fruit, with your name on a stick beside it.

success.text: You pick every one. Your bag is full of Berries.

events.name: New Moon
events.intro: **"No moon tonight. Stay in, or go out into the dark."**

success.text: You go out into the dark. Dark-types prowl all week, and once, at the darkest hour, a shape with a single blue eye passes over you.
You stay in. Everyone rests.

events.name: Full Moon
events.intro: **"Stand in the moonlight, and be well."**

success.text: You stand in the full moon with your team. It is cool and kind, and it heals. Somewhere above, a shape like a crescent drifts across the moon.

events.name: Friday the 13th
events.intro: **"Unlucky day! Or is it?"** Black Purrloin on every wall.

success.text: You carry a charm all day. Nothing bad happens. Nothing good either. That is the charm.
You embrace it. First a bad thing: you trip in a puddle and your whole team gets a soaking. Then a good thing: in the puddle, a Nugget.

events.name: Palindrome Day
events.intro: **"Today reads the same both ways."**

success.text: You look in a shop window and your reflection waves a moment too late. All week, mirror matches are waiting on the road: your own team, the other way round.

events.name: Weekend Warm-Up
events.intro: **"It's Friday! Celebrate!"**

success.text: You celebrate. Prize money is a tenth better until the week is out.

events.name: Shiny Charm Day
events.intro: **"Today, shiny odds are doubled. Look closely!"**

success.text: You look closely at every Pokémon you see. Shiny odds are doubled while the day lasts.
